title: RAMP: Recurrent Adaptive Mixed Precision for Efficient Prefill in Recurrent-Depth Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.13041v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Recurrent-depth language models improve inference-time reasoning by repeatedly applying a shared network to refine internal representations, but the additional recurrent computation also increases inference cost. This overhead is particularly pronounced during long-context prefill, where the full input sequence is repeatedly processed across recurrent depth. Weight-and-activation quantization offers a natural way to accelerate this computation through lower-precision arithmetic, yet repeatedly applying quantized computation introduces numerical perturbations that accumulate along the recurrent trajectory. We systematically analyze how such errors propagate across recurrent depth and show that quantization errors introduced earlier are attenuated by more subsequent recurrent steps and therefore have a smaller effect on the final representation. translated_title: RAMP：面向循环深度语言模型高效预填充的循环自适应混合精度方法
translated_abstract: 循环深度语言模型通过反复应用一个共享网络来精炼内部表示，从而提升推理时的推理能力，但这种额外的循环计算也增加了推理成本。这一开销在长上下文预填充阶段尤为显著，因为在预填充时，完整的输入序列会沿循环深度被反复处理。权重与激活量化提供了一种通过低精度算术来加速此类计算的自然途径，然而反复应用量化计算会引入沿循环轨迹不断累积的数值扰动。我们系统地分析了这类误差如何在循环深度上传播，并证明较早引入的量化误差会被后续更多的循环步骤所衰减，因而对最终表示的影响更小。匹配计算预算的实验有力地支持了这一预测，表明将量化计算放置在……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出RAMP方法，通过揭示“越早引入的量化误差会被越多后续循环步骤衰减”这一传播规律，将量化计算自适应地放置在合适的循环步骤上，从而在保持精度的同时高效加速循环深度语言模型的长上下文预填充。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes RAMP, which exploits the finding that quantization errors introduced earlier in recurrent depth are attenuated by more subsequent recurrent steps, adaptively placing mixed-precision computation to enable efficient prefill in recurrent-depth language models.
